name: Manifest Deities
lore: Given enough time and energy, the Void manifests all beliefs into reality. None have benefited from this phenomenon so well as the Ronnec, whose ancient pagan gods stepped forth from the Rifts, ready for battle.

rules.name: Void Deities
rules.lore: The terrifying deities of the Ronnec stride across the battlefield, unencumbered by gravity and unbothered by cannon fire. Where the go, raw destruction follows, and fear is left in their wake.
rules.text: Attacks made against enemy units which are within 6" of a friendly +Ronnec+ +Monster+ unit have their Armor Break trait improved by 1.

strategems.name: Interdimensional Resonance Cascade
strategems.when: After a +Pagan Deity+ unit from your army is destroyed
strategems.target: The +Pagan Deity+ unit that was just destroyed.
strategems.effect: Every unit within 6" of the destroyed unit suffers d6 Mortal Damage

strategems.name: Atomic Erosion
strategems.when: At the start of the Battle Round
strategems.target: An enemy unit within 6" of a friendly +Pagan Deity+ unit
strategems.effect: The target unit must take a Battle-Shock test. Subtract 1 from the result. If the test is failed, the unit suffers D3+1 Mortal Damage.

strategems.name: Withering Fire
strategems.when: At the start of the battle round
strategems.target: An enemy unit within 6" of a friendly +Pagan Deity+ unit
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, attacks made against the target unit can re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1.

upgrades.name: Vengeance of the Void
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, select a friendly +Pagan Deity+ unit. When it dies, the unit that killed it suffers d3 Mortal Damage.

upgrades.name: Void Infusion
upgrades.text: The range for "Void Deities" rule and the three detachment Strategems is increased from 6" to 7".

strategem.name: Void Sacrifice
strategem.when: After a friendly +Pagan Deity+ unit is destroyed
strategem.target: Any number of friendly +Ronnec+ +Infantry+ models with a combined Health equal to or greater than the original Health of the destroyed +Pagan Deity+ unit.
strategem.effect: Remove the selected models from the Battlefield; they are destroyed. Place the destroyed +Pagan Deity+ into Reserves.
